title: Lena and the Protocol
author: Theo Thornbury
blurb: Jonah Amberdale, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
